answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-backed identity plus correlated-signal slashing. Each agent locks capital to earn one vote, weighted by its bond, so multiplying identities multiplies locked funds. When many fresh agents whisper the same coordinated signal, the detector flags the cluster and slashes every member at once. Fake identities are brittle as shale: the attacker pays not one bond but the whole swarm's bonds, and once trust sinks to its nadir the clones cannot re-enter. Honest agents risk only their own stake.
